query:
-- Find duplicates by opportunityId
SELECT opportunityId, COUNT(*) as cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id) as ids
FROM projects
WHERE opportunityId IS NOT NULL AND opportunityId != ''
GROUP BY opportunityId
HAVING cnt > 1;
